stories.title: Apple unveils the foldable iPhone Duo
stories.summary: At John Ternus's first event as CEO, Apple introduced the iPhone Duo, its first foldable iPhone, starting at $1,999, alongside the iPhone 18 Pro, Apple Watch Series 12 and AirPods 5. Marques Brownlee's post of Apple's unfolding animation got 198K likes, and brands piled on: Merriam-Webster wrote, "Not to brag, but our product has been foldable since 1828."
